# Standard guy kit for masts

We decided that every free-standing AWS mast will use the same three-point
guy kit unless a site has an existing approved structure that removes the
need. Earlier stations used whatever anchors and line were available, which
made inspection and replacement needlessly different from site to site.

## Decision

The standard kit is three equal runs of weather-resistant guy line, matching
ground anchors, thimbles, and labelled tension points. The mast installer
sets the line angle from the mast height and records any deviation in the
site notes. A volunteer should be able to recognise the fittings without
having to identify the original supplier.

## Consequence

This adds a little setup time at new sites, but means a spare kit can support
any station. The collector mast is included in the same approach, although
its final anchor positions must avoid the access path.
